- The active goal surviv"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"es server restarts (`current-goal.txt`)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 4. Dual-role validation (anti self-grading)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`set_acceptance_criteria` accepts a `role` parameter (`agent` / `reviewer` /

results) is high-confidence."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"### 6. Task decomposition with dependency validation"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"`set_task_plan` lets you decompose a goal into atomic tasks, each with a
